def generate_palindrome(length):
    if length < 1:
        return ""
    
    # Start with a base string
    base = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    
    # Create the first half of the palindrome
    half_length = (length + 1) // 2
    half = base[:half_length]
    
    # Reverse the half to create the second part
    second_half = half[::-1]
    
    # Combine both parts to form a palindrome
    palindrome = half + half[-2::-1] if length % 2 == 0 else half + half[-1::-1]
    
    return palindrome
